sets.title: Starter set: Reading and Writing
sets.description: Ten questions across all four Reading and Writing domains. A good first look at every question type.

sets.title: Starter set: Math
sets.description: Ten questions across algebra, advanced math, data and geometry, including typed-answer questions.

sets.title: Skill set: Boundaries
sets.description: Ten questions on joining and separating clauses: semicolons, colons, dashes, commas, and when to use no punctuation at all.

sets.title: Skill set: Form, Structure, and Sense
sets.description: Ten questions on subject-verb agreement, pronouns, possessives, verb tense and form, and modifiers.

sets.title: Skill set: Transitions
sets.description: Ten questions on choosing the transition that matches the logic: contrast, cause and effect, example, concession, and more.

sets.title: Skill set: Words in Context
sets.description: Ten questions on choosing the most precise word for the context, plus what a word most nearly means.

sets.title: Skill set: Linear equations in one variable
sets.description: Ten questions on solving linear equations, including word problems and equations with no solution or infinitely many solutions.

sets.title: Skill set: Nonlinear functions
sets.description: Ten questions on quadratic and exponential functions: evaluating, modeling, the vertex and minimum, growth and decay.
